subject.title: feat(cli): `skills uninstall` design proposal + prior art reconciliation

question: Should OpenClaw add a destructive `openclaw skills uninstall <slug>` CLI command for ClawHub-tracked skills now, and what exact scope should it have?
rationale: The missing command is source-supported, but deleting local skill files and lockfile state affects manual skills, global versus agent workspaces, prompts, JSON output, and security containment, so automation should not choose the user-facing contract.

options.title: Approve narrow CLI uninstall
options.body: Add a focused workspace/global ClawHub uninstall command with safe path resolution, confirmation or `--yes`, `--dry-run`, `--json`, lockfile cleanup, and regression tests.

options.title: Prefer Gateway/UI lifecycle first
options.body: Keep this issue open but redirect the first implementation to a Gateway lifecycle method if operator UI parity is the desired product surface.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Leave manual deletion/documented workarounds in place until maintainers decide ClawHub skill lifecycle belongs outside the OpenClaw CLI.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow CLI uninstall
recommendation.body: Add a focused workspace/global ClawHub uninstall command with safe path resolution, confirmation or `--yes`, `--dry-run`, `--json`, lockfile cleanup, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the native ClawHub skill lifecycle and is the strongest local history owner for the command surface this issue would extend.
